purpose: Describe one physical item, its inspection, and a qualified forecast without inventing approval or arrival.

identityRules.sameCandidate: Equal owner-recognized asset labels in the same inventory
identityRules.different: Different owner-recognized labels, even when display names match
identityRules.aliasRule: A scoped alias may reference an owner-recognized entity ID; similarity or alias text alone remains unresolved

identityRules.sameCandidate: The same recorded observation, not every report about the item
identityRules.different: A new inspection or correction retains the earlier observation
identityRules.aliasRule: A source occurrence ID is evidence identity, not physical-item identity

identityRules.scope: one attributed expectation and source revision
identityRules.sameCandidate: The same attributed forecast at the same revision
identityRules.different: A possible event, its observed completion, and a revised forecast are separate records
identityRules.aliasRule: The supplier label does not authenticate a named actor

relationships.meaning: Loan deliberation depends on inspection evidence; the edge does not claim success or approval
relationships.reverseMeaning: The reverse is not the same dependency

relationships.meaning: The forecast informs unresolved inspection context; it is not an observed repair

assertionRequirements: optional object or value; null for unary assertions
explicit native-projection omission when the vocabulary is lossy

questions.question: What prevents lending the blue telescope?
questions.meaningCheck: The answer preserves the failed/incomplete check, missing cap, and need for a new inspection; it records no approved loan.

questions.question: Who signed the lunar station maintenance order?
questions.meaningCheck: An empty selection is retrieval behavior, not proof of global absence or semantic answer grading.

authority: Reference definitions and known-case expectations only. No admission, canonical merge, authenticated review, processing consent, disclosure, or effects.
